economy.summary: Her campaign says she promotes job and economic growth policies to make Pennsylvania more competitive for job creators.
economy.short: Promotes job and economic growth policies for job creators.

taxes.summary: Co-sponsored the House Republicans' Freedom Through Affordability legislation to temporarily suspend the Gross Receipts Tax on electricity and telecommunications for six months, which she described as a commonsense way to give families a break from rising costs.
taxes.short: Co-sponsored bill to suspend gross receipts tax on utilities six months.

abortion.summary: Voted no on final passage of House Bill 1957, a proposed state constitutional amendment providing for personal reproductive liberty, in December 2025.
abortion.short: Voted no on constitutional amendment for personal reproductive liberty.

education.summary: Her campaign says she supports a quality education that prioritizes in-person learning and focuses resources on classrooms, and cites record investment in both traditional public education and school choice initiatives.
education.short: Supports in-person learning, classroom resources, public education and school choice.

energy.summary: Is a sponsor of the House Republicans' 11-bill energy package, which would streamline energy permitting, eliminate the Gross Receipts Tax on electric utilities, and prioritize baseload generation such as natural gas, nuclear and coal; she said Pennsylvania is the nation's largest electricity exporter yet families still face higher energy costs.
energy.short: Sponsors energy package streamlining permitting, cutting utility tax, backing baseload generation.

guns.summary: Her campaign says she supports funding police to protect the community and prevent crime in the district's neighborhoods; the statement addresses public safety and does not detail a position on firearms.
guns.short: Supports funding police to protect the community and prevent crime.

economy.summary: Her campaign platform calls for policies that increase housing affordability, protect renters and support first-time homebuyers, and for reducing barriers and providing resources so local small businesses can thrive.
economy.short: Supports housing affordability, renter protections, first-time buyers, small business support.

education.summary: Her campaign platform says schools need proper funding, support for educators and resources for every student, and that she will prioritize education funding and teacher support.
education.short: Will prioritize education funding, teacher support, and school resources.

healthcare.summary: Her campaign platform's senior care and disability services plank calls for expanded services, accessible healthcare, and programs to keep seniors and residents with disabilities safe and healthy.
healthcare.short: Advocates expanded services and accessible healthcare for seniors and disabled.
